title: Work with a list
objective: Store several values together, count them, and visit each one.

body.text: A list holds several values in order. make a list of creates one from comma-separated values. Positions start at 0, so nums at 0 is the first item.

body.title: Visit every item
body.code:
make nums equal to a list of 4, 8
repeat for each n in nums
    say "{n}"
say "Count: {size of nums}"

body.text: size of gives the number of items. repeat for each visits the items in order. A list can only be changed with set if it was made changing.

body.prompt: The program prints each number but never says how many there are. Make it print Count: 3 after the list.
body.starter:
make nums equal to a list of 4, 8, 15
repeat for each n in nums
    say "{n}"
body.solution:
make nums equal to a list of 4, 8, 15
repeat for each n in nums
    say "{n}"
say "Count: {size of nums}"
